infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Builds the Python 3.12 backend image, installs the application and curl, provisions persistent-data storage, exposes port 8000, and starts the FastAPI app with Uvicorn.

infrastructure.name: python
infrastructure.summary: Defines the Python runtime service that hosts Assumption Zero through Uvicorn on port 8000 with its data directory under /app.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Builds the Vite frontend in Node.js and serves the production assets from Nginx with SPA fallback routing and an /api proxy to the backend service.

infrastructure.name: builder
infrastructure.summary: Installs locked frontend dependencies in Node.js 20 and compiles the Vite application into production assets.

infrastructure.name: nginx
infrastructure.summary: Serves the compiled frontend on port 80, falls back to index.html for client-side routes, and proxies API requests to the backend container.

infrastructure.name: ci.yml
infrastructure.summary: Runs continuous integration on pushes and pull requests to main or master, executing the Python 3.12 pytest suite and independently installing and building the Node.js 20 frontend.

infrastructure.name: docker-compose.yml
infrastructure.summary: Orchestrates backend and frontend containers, exposes the API and web ports, persists analysis data, forwards provider configuration, adds an API health check, and starts the frontend after the backend.

list.description: Container topology, CI, development launchers, environment settings, package manifests, build tools, repository templates, and knowledge-graph configuration.
